message.ctrcraft.track.selected: Selected %s. Right-click another node to link it.

screen.ctrcraft.spot.title: Power-up of this crate

message.ctrcraft.kart.upgrade_added: Upgrade installed. Switch it on with the Wrench.

screen.ctrcraft.kart.title: Kart settings

screen.ctrcraft.kart.locked_hint: Craft it and use it on the kart to unlock this switch.
tooltip.ctrcraft.rulebook.temporary: Applies to the next race only
